name: stage_wp6_features
title: STAGE WP6 features (human-facing questionnaire, prefilled from EHR)
purpose: Generated from fhir-feature-mapping-v3.xlsx by generate_stage_wp6_v3.py. Prefills the stage_wp6_features Questionnaire from Patient/Observation/Condition/FamilyMemberHistory resources and previously-saved external questionnaire responses (WHO-5/HDI-1..4/PHQ-2). The user reviews/edits/completes the prefilled answers before saving; stage_wp6_model_features (hop 2) then reads back the saved response.
